classification.A: Existing canonical primitive; complete theme journey still needs integration proof
classification.B: Existing capability whose target wiring/readback needs verification
classification.C: Bounded extension under existing domain owner
classification.D: Material product, policy or provider/source decision

features.name: Navigation, basic search and product identity/INR price/options
features.owner: commerce-core / gateway product query / existing navigation and Liquid drops
features.requiredProof: Use real public same-site products and supported query fields; server stock and variant identity

features.name: Versioned Trailmark composition and exact preview
features.requiredProof: Actual package/version survives catalog Add, resource binding, saved draft, signed preview, explicit publication and immutable release; no rewrite of existing ride instances

features.name: Typed recreational equipment facts
features.owner: shared-types / commerce-core / merchant product editor / public data binding
features.requiredProof: Validated bounded namespace, merchant edit/readback, allowlisted safe public Liquid projection; unknown stays unknown; clothing and equipment schemas switch together

features.name: Activity, type and measured-size filters/sort
features.owner: canonical paginated product query and existing storefront discovery island
features.requiredProof: Allowlisted category-specific query contract, indexed pagination, supplied totals, query/back retention and clear-one behavior; omit unsupported controls from production

features.name: Technical measurement presentation
features.owner: Liquid product facts block under theme-engine
features.requiredProof: Written units agree with selected variant; diagram is explicitly illustrative and not to scale; no measurements inferred from AI photo

features.name: Compatibility statements
features.requiredProof: Source-backed normalized facts or unconfirmed label. No universal matcher or compare engine is advertised

features.name: Independent related products
features.owner: existing resource bindings and public product drops
features.requiredProof: Explicit curated list of same-site public product links; independent prices/stock; no automatic kit or component inventory coupling

features.name: Quantity, cart, checkout and mock payment recovery
features.owner: existing server cart, checkout-core and canonical hosted checkout
features.requiredProof: Server repricing, stock handling, retained variant, idempotent retry, eligibility and truthful mock/sandbox mode; permitted branding data only

features.name: Shipping eligibility and delivery conditions
features.requiredProof: Rate returned for actual address. Mock fixture shows90 INR, not a production promise; delivery date absent without trusted result

features.name: Canonical buyer sign-in/register/Continue
features.requiredProof: Email/password, configured Turnstile, signup min8; successful identity session then explicit Continue to Trailmark or another account; validated tenant-bound OAuth redirect; no mandatory automatic email code

features.name: Profile/address/order ownership
features.owner: canonical buyer accounts / gateway scoped buyer routes
features.requiredProof: Normal auth, direct-owned-order read, cross-buyer denial, store-scoped history, address edit/add/default validation and persistence. UI screenshots do not prove any mutation

features.name: Genuine reviews
features.requiredProof: No reviews yet in mockup. Only published reviews may render when wired; no invented rating

features.name: Safety-critical gear fitting, regulated equipment and certification
features.requiredProof: Outside initial recreation scope; separate material product approval required

features.name: Activity booking, autonomous size recommendations, bundles, cross-merchant wallet or headless storefront

handoff: Coordinator assigns one named writer for shared changes after all nine mockup packs pass. This pack changes no production source or schema.
